The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of the inoceramids in the Carpathian foredeep and marginal Carpathians is an indicator for the presence of a shallow water marine environment, which is a prerequisite for a shallow-water carbonate deposition.
the presence or absence of a specific species is a good indicator of the temperature and salinity of the ocean at the time of deposition.
the Cretaceous-Paleocene boundary in the Carpathians is not a major hiatus.
